finding.conclusion: The observed stop is a model precondition failure before dispatch. Source establishes a valid counter-schedule under normal polling, so removing this additional chronology constraint is justified. The report does not establish a production defect or reveal exact own/current timestamps, and does not prove that later advance/lease checks would pass after removal.
